title: S12T04 - Enforce verification evidence subject matching
description: verifySubject checks selected evidence existence and passed outcome, but the domain function should also reject evidence for a different subjectId or subjectType.
acceptanceCriteria: verifySubject rejects cross-subject and cross-subjectType evidence with actionable error details.
Runtime and CLI tests cover mixed evidence lists and attempted passed verification using another work item's evidence.
closedReason: Evidence subject matching enforced and verified
